user.title: Set up Entfeuchterkosten
user.description: Calculates the electricity costs of a dehumidifier from its power sensor, for example the one of a smart plug. Power generated by solar panels at the same time is free and is offset against it.

data_description.name: The name of the device that holds the cost sensors.
data_description.power_entity: The sensor that measures the power of the dehumidifier, in W or kW.
data_description.solar_entity: The power generated by solar panels at the same time, for example a balcony solar plant. It is free: only the dehumidifier's power above it counts towards the costs. Leave empty if you have none.
data_description.price: The price of one kWh, including all taxes and fees.

error.same_entity: The solar power sensor must be a different sensor than the dehumidifier's power sensor.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already used by another Entfeuchterkosten entry.
